name: deepseek-harness-bridge
description: Start, open, and control DeepSeek Harness from Codex through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate Codex tasks to a visible local DSH session.
interface.longDescription: Starts or reuses a loopback DeepSeek Harness Web runtime, opens it in Codex's built-in browser, and provides relevance-based session reuse, deliberate workspace placement, bounded history, permission ceilings, and exact user-action handoff.
defaultPrompt: Start DeepSeek Harness and open it in the Codex side panel.
Continue a specific DeepSeek Harness session and wait only for its new result.
List DSH workspaces and ask where a new unrelated task should run.
